tweets.text:
I know people have been making grave allegations against Loom lately, and I don’t know if they have merit.

But people massively underestimate the mental impact of having a phone in their hands or pocket on their ability to focus on the present moment. It goes far beyond cinema, gym, studying, meals, family time, sleep… Anything requiring attention.

This is not slop. Although the concept isn’t novel, such devices have the potential for a massive worldwide market and to change the world for the better. Phone addiction is a poison; look inside any city restaurant or public transport. People don’t enjoy each other’s presence and are more like walking zombies hypnotized by their phones.

I support the idea. Distribution and marketing are the key issues. People haven’t read the massive body of literature or lack the IQ to understand the stakes and applications.

This is the kind of step I like to see toward public understanding of how badly phones affect our relationships and health.

Disclaimer: I didn’t invest in LoomLock. I am fortunately not rekt by monetary controversies that may or may not be true (no clue). I just like what I see and feel it gets hated undeservedly.

tweets.text:
$BTC looks like it’s forming a short-term bottom around the $84K area.

I could see one final push toward $88K before another leg lower into the low $80Ks.

If the downside continues, I’d be watching the 50W MA around $79K as a deeper support zone. 

The 50W MA is an important medium-to-long-term trend indicator and can act as support during larger pullbacks.

So the levels I’m watching:

$84K → short-term base

$88K → potential relief-rally resistance

Low $80Ks → next downside target

~$79K → 50W MA / deeper support

A short-term bounce doesn’t necessarily mean the broader correction is over.

$BTC September has been a rollercoaster so far but the past week has seen a big turn around.

And Q4 is coming up. And Q4 is what is historically Bitcoin's best quarter.

But in a bear market year, Q4 is also when BTC sets its bottom.

This is why a lot of investors have been waiting for early October to deploy, believing that is when the BTC bottom will be set for this bear market year.

But Bitcoin has clearly not been respecting its previous kind of seasonality and 4 year cycle movements for a while now. So those waiting for new lows by October might see their plans changed I would imagine.
